FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you only work with large contractors?

No. Our Starter package is designed specifically for 1-3 person crews just getting established. We scale with your business from local startup to regional leader. Whether you're installing your first residential court or managing multiple commercial projects, we have solutions that fit.

What's your guarantee?

We guarantee 300+ monthly organic website visitors within 90 days or we refund your full setup fee. No questions asked. This reflects our confidence in our proven systems and our commitment to measurable results.

How is this different from other marketing agencies?

We specialize exclusively in sports surfaces. We understand ASBA certification, project bid cycles, commercial vs. residential markets, and supplier relationships. Our team includes former facility owners and contractor business experts who know the difference between selling to homeowners vs. property managers, schools, and commercial clients.

Do you work with manufacturers too?

Yes. Our network model connects certified installers with quality suppliers. Manufacturers join our exclusive partner network for lead distribution and co-marketing opportunities. Contractors get preferred pricing and support, while manufacturers get direct access to qualified installers.

How quickly will I see results?

Basic website improvements show within 30 days. SEO rankings typically improve in 60-90 days. Lead quality improves immediately through better website conversion. Every client is different, but our proven timeline helps set realistic expectations.

What if I'm already working with another marketing company?

We specialize in sports surfaces -- they don't. Many clients work with us for industry-specific marketing while maintaining general marketing elsewhere. Our expertise complements general marketing services by targeting the unique aspects of the sports surface industry.

What types of contractors do you work with?

We work with tennis court builders, pickleball installers, basketball court contractors, multi-sport facility builders, and court resurfacing specialists. Our clients range from residential specialists to commercial contractors handling school districts, municipalities, and private clubs.

How much does a website cost?

Our website packages start at $1,999 setup for template-based sites, up to $8,999 for premium custom designs with advanced features. All websites include mobile optimization, SEO foundation, industry-specific content, and ongoing maintenance.

How long until I see results from SEO?

Local SEO results typically begin showing within 30-60 days. Commercial keyword rankings develop over 60-120 days for competitive terms. We provide monthly reports so you can track progress.

Can you help with Google Ads?

Yes, Google Ads management is included in our Pro and Elite packages, or available as an add-on for 15% of your monthly ad spend. We create campaigns targeting commercial prospects and qualified leads to maximize your return.

Do I need to provide content?

No. We create all website content, blog posts, and marketing materials based on your business and our industry expertise. You provide project photos and basic company information. We handle all copywriting and content marketing.

What's your contract length?

We offer month-to-month contracts because we believe in earning your business every month with results. Most clients stay with us for years because the results speak for themselves, but you're free to cancel with 30 days notice.

How do you measure success?

We track website traffic, search rankings, lead quality, and most importantly, your actual business results: more qualified inquiries and higher-value projects. Monthly reports show the metrics that matter to your bottom line.

What makes you different from a regular web agency?

Industry specialization. We know the difference between residential pickleball courts vs. commercial tennis facilities, understand ASBA certification value, and target the right prospects. Plus, our contractor network creates additional opportunities through referrals and supplier partnerships.
